batch_size_contract.scope: No hard-coded logical batch size; supported sizes are bounded by the qualified executor and available resources, not an unlimited-memory claim.

run_spec.total_edits: N, nonnegative integer; never inferred from a fixed batch count
run_spec.edit_batch_size: B, positive integer, or an explicit positive-size batch schedule summing to N
run_spec.actual_batch_size: B_t derived from remaining occurrences; retain the final partial batch without dropping or dummy edits
run_spec.completion: Exactly N ordered edit occurrences successfully committed
run_spec.evaluation_milestones: Cumulative edit counts, independent of batch ordinals

independent_execution_sizes.G_fit: Complete active requests per fit graph, with token budget and optional per-request row accumulation
independent_execution_sizes.G_capture: Native writer-context rows per capture graph, independent of fit grouping
independent_execution_sizes.G_eval: Evaluation rows per graph, independent of logical B and the other phases

semantic_rules: Resource autotuning changes execution grouping only, never logical B, edit order or the logical schedule.
Changing logical B can change joint-writer coupling, history timing and scientific outcomes; batch-size independence does not mean result invariance.
Changing only execution grouping at fixed logical batches requires reference parity, including request-local moments, stopping and selected candidate.
Keep per-request shared budget, norm coefficient and native context/token reductions independent of logical B and active-request count.
For row accumulation, include request-level regularizers once, preserve original weights and decide stop from the complete request objective.
Retain separate occurrence IDs for duplicate facts and preserve the original write order.
Capture and transfers may stream; do not replace a whole-batch writer by independent microbatch writes.
Out-of-memory retry cannot advance request moments/step counters twice or silently reduce the logical batch.
Stage only active request variables and optimizer state on GPU if necessary; preserve inactive state without reinitialization.
History appends exactly once after each successful logical commit using its actual request count and native final-state reduction.

milestone_policy.default: Evaluate at the first completed logical commit at or after each requested milestone; record both requested and actual edited counts and share one evaluation if several milestones map to one state.
milestone_policy.exact_count: An exact intermediate count requires an explicit predeclared logical batch schedule containing that boundary.
milestone_policy.comparison: Compare equal actual edited counts and ordered prefixes; do not label a 512-edit endpoint as 500 edits.
milestone_policy.denominators: Derive from actual benchmark evaluation occurrences and metric definitions, never fixed multiples of B.

large_batch_writer.reference: One native solve using the whole logical batch; capture chunking does not partition the solve.
large_batch_writer.optional_statistics: C_K = sum_j K_j K_j^T; T_KR = sum_j K_j R_j^T; AlphaEdit algebra: solve(Pi(C_K + H) + lambda I, Pi T_KR).
large_batch_writer.qualification: Streaming accumulation and reassociation of Pi multiplications change native FP32 reduction order. This is a separately qualified numeric backend, not a bitwise-equivalent default.
large_batch_writer.resource_limit: Layer-width matrices still require resources; report an unsupported resource requirement if no qualified path fits.

optimizations.current: One complete request per graph; 2500 physical F and 2400 B in historical B1.
optimizations.proposal: Token-aware groups of complete active requests, independent per-request losses/moments/steps; sum continuing request F for backward. Vectorize optimizer over requests; materialize only current group D columns.
optimizations.effect: Utilization and call/synchronization overhead; same logical work. Example G4 gives625F600B for B100 all25/24, not guaranteed4x speed.

optimizations.current: CPU entry caches/teacher retransferred; all five projectors loaded to GPU before fit.
optimizations.proposal: Cache residency selected by phase; load Pi only during writer, one layer at a time; jointly tune G and checkpoint segments under real memory budget.
optimizations.effect: Frees about3.83GiB of current-profile projector storage during fit; no universal fixed memory saving.

optimizations.current: Every candidate full canonical z to CPU; many scalar GPU reads; per-event open/validate/flush.
optimizations.proposal: Same-forward captures stay on GPU; copy full z only for terminal requests; batch diagnostic reductions/transfers; bounded event writer with boundary flush and unchanged row identities/content.
optimizations.effect: CPU synchronization/transfer/I/O overhead; not model FLOPs.

optimizations.current: Cache first key and residual; repeat first down_proj per candidate.
optimizations.proposal: Cache full native block output immediately before earliest eligible delta injection; valid for frozen batch-entry dependencies.
optimizations.effect: Current feature portion shrinks18432 to4096, factor4.5 excluding mask/metadata; first projection forward removed. Not4.5x total speed.

optimizations.current: Each layer key/h capture runs every model block;600 capture forwards in historical B1.
optimizations.proposal: Stop at last requested block output; use only native writer rows, independent writer capture microbatch.
optimizations.effect: Current32-block profile capture stages192 to44 block executions/group including final capture; operation count proxy only.

optimizations.current: New/true candidates often repeat identical model inputs; W0 reuse may be prevented by unrelated full-task identity.
optimizations.proposal: Deduplicate identical deterministic forward signatures at same state, fan out scoring to all original rows; separate evaluator-relevant W0 dependency identity.
optimizations.effect: True forward work removal; current one-token targets are especially favorable.

optimizations.proposal: Stage all current rows to next eligible layer, assemble whole-batch K/R, solve/write once, resume with actual new block outputs. Keep bounded stage caches; compute new upper keys after lower writes.
Use own-prewrite key as final-state key only when downstream writes cannot affect it and own changed weight is downstream of key; append after all writes in original native order.
requires: no parameter alias or recurrent feedback
optimizations.fallback: Explicit final capture unchanged when capability unavailable.

optimizations.proposal: Consider projected basis, Woodbury or rank-update factors only as separately qualified numeric backend after profiling.
optimizations.default: Keep native FP32 nonsymmetric solve and order.
